However, if NPA's did not improve in fuel economy the increased size of the NPA fleet projected for 1979 would result in increased energy consumption, increased use of national resources, and decreased water and air quality and increased industrial water supply demand. b. Extend the scope of the standard to include NPA's above 6,000 pounds GVWR. The Act gives the Secretary of Transportation the discretion to establish AFES's for vehicles greater than 6,000 pounds GVWR but less than 10,000 pounds GVWR. Baseline fuel economy data from which to establish standards for MY 1979 were available from EPA for vehicles under 6,000 pounds GVWR. EPA could not supply data for heavier vehicles. The NHTSA did not have time to develop its own data base for MY 1979. Therefore, this alternative was rejected for MY 1979.
